root_cause: NW HF Frequency Domain solver started and entered adaptive mesh refinement pass 1, but CST reported that Ports 2 and 3 had at least one endpoint not connected to a good conductor. The solver then failed with The mesh near lumped element "2" seems to be corrupted. The current P2/P3 discrete-port segment runs from the outer/front signal-copper surface n=+0.035 to the outer/back ground-copper surface n=-1.035, so the lumped-element line traverses the finite-thickness lossy copper sheets. CST explicitly warns that the element must not pass through PEC or lossy metal.
cst_warning: Ports 2, 3: at least one endpoint is not connected to any good conductor.
cst_error: The mesh near the lumped element "2" seems to be corrupted.

port_fix.intent: port segment spans FR4 only and terminates on copper/FR4 interfaces; no traversal through lossy metal
